Annual event (world quest) in which the whole server helps the witches of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} prepare a powerful spirit potion. You gather exotic ingredients in the cauldron and protect the room from the {creature:Bane Bringer|Bane Bringers}. You earn favour points to trade for potions and for a Raven with {npc:Minzy}, up to 8 achievements and, if the world succeeds, +50% experience for 10 days.

To avoid the wrath of the evil spirits, all Tibians will have to help the good witches create a powerful spirit potion. Gather exotic ingredients and protect the witches' cauldron from the forces of destruction.

The cauldron needs about **200** units of the requested ingredient in each phase, in total for the server (not per person). You can put in as many as you like until it's full.
Bane Bringers die easily to {wiki:Physical Damage|physical} damage.
Favour points you don't spend carry over to next year's event.

The event takes place under the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}, near **Venore**. There are several entrances; this is one of them. Bring a {item:Machete}, {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel}. The swamp is between Kazordoon and Venore; from Venore, leave the city and head **west** to the marked entrance.
Along the way there are {creature:Snake|Snakes} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.
Go down to the event area
Go down several floors until you reach the witches' cauldron area.
To leave, go back the same way: climb the floors you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes if needed) to the entrance in the Green Claw Swamp and head **east** to Venore.

A new phase starts every **8 hours** from the 21 June Server Save. At the start of the event you see the message *"The witches of the green claw swamp need your help to protect the world from the bane-bringers."* and in each phase *"The swamp witches need new reagents for their brew!"*. The {item:Witch's Clock|Witch's Clocks} around the cauldron show how many hours are left until the next phase.

Each phase's ingredient appears on the altars to the left and right of the cauldron; only that one is accepted, and only until the requested amount is reached. The first is always {item:Lump of Dirt}; the following ones are random and can repeat. In a room before the cauldron area (on the floor above) all the possible ingredients are on display.
A {item:Bewitched (Book)|book} near the cauldron explains what to do.
Use the cauldron's **lower right edge** and then use it on the ingredient (as if using a tool). Each unit gives favour points.

The {item:Dry Piece of Wood|Dry Pieces of Wood} you loot from Bane Bringers give extra favour points. Use the wood on the cauldron's **chute**, not on the cauldron. Wood doesn't affect the event's success: the world does **not lose** if nobody puts in wood.

At the fixed end of each phase the ingredient must be delivered. If the server can't manage it, the event ends there and there are no more phases. On logging in you see *"The curse of the bane-bringer has come over Tibia. Prepare for dire times!"*
The effects of failure aren't known yet.

{creature:Bane Bringer|Bane Bringers} attack the room **below the cauldron** at the start of each phase (except the first) and in raids: from server start-up there is a raid chance exactly every **25 minutes** (20 to 35 Bane Bringers per raid). To know the schedule, note the time of a raid and add 25 minutes (e.g. raid at 12:03:55 → next chances at 12:28:55, 12:53:55…). The interval carries on even if there is no raid and rolls over to the next day, regardless of Server Save.

Kill them with physical attacks to loot {item:Dry Piece of Wood}. If they aren't killed they disappear after **10 minutes**. In raids that aren't ingredient raids, the boss {creature:Bane Lord} can appear, carrying up to 3 pieces of wood and some {wiki:Taming Items}.
After contributing, talk to {npc:Minzy} next to the cauldron. You can ask about {key:job}, {key:ingredients}, {key:favour} or {key:trade}. Use {key:trade} to exchange the points.
What you can buy with favour points:
You can only buy **one** {item:Raven Kit} per year per character.
Achievements you can earn during the event (22 points in total, or 20 without I Did My Part, which is also earned in other events):
Put in any ingredient or wood
If the server completes all the phases, the whole {wiki:Game World|world} gets **+50% experience for 10 days**.
Until 2018 the event ran from 12 to 16 January; it moved to June with the arrival of the {wiki:Winterlight Solstice}.

In 2019 the {item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers}, {item:Bonelord Eye|Bonelord Eyes} and {item:Vampire Dust} were replaced by {item:Marsh Stalker Beak|Marsh Stalker Beaks}, {item:Small Flask of Eyedrops} and {item:Lancet|Lancets}, and the experience bonus went up from 20% to 50%.
